استقذروا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْذَرُوا (istaqḏarū) /is.taq.ða.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اُسْتُقْذِرُوا (ustuqḏirū) /us.tuq.ði.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذِرُوا (istaqḏirū) /is.taq.ði.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
